audit.why: 52.75% over 1054 games, diff FAV 6/10, chart Urgot/Urgot/Skill/Urgot/Galio/Urgot/Urgot. This matches the already-audited Galio side of the mirror exactly (Galio's page rates the lane HARD 8.5/10 with the inverse chart), so no chart flips are proposed.
audit.corrected: Lane stays favoured for Urgot: he owns levels 1-5 and every item spike; Galio's only owned row is Level 6 when Hero's Entrance comes online.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere — the packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and sequencingCues is 0.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11/10/9/8/7s and is Galio's only gap-closer and only disengage. Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140s. Urgot's Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and carries his shield; Purge falls from 12s to no cooldown and no cost at rank 5; Corrosive Charge 10s at 800 range; Fear Beyond Death 100/85/70s at 2500.
audit.corrected: Advice is now keyed to Justice Punch's 11s rank-1 cooldown and Hero's Entrance's 180s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the decisive interactions: Colossal Smash is an auto-attack reset that telegraphs his commit, and Shield of Durand reduces incoming physical damage while charged.
audit.why: Galio's passive wind-up is the tell before the Justice Punch engage, so the cue to step back is the wind-up rather than the ability cast. Shield of Durand's physical reduction means Purge sprayed into a charged stance is wasted — spray after he releases the taunt. Per the mirror, Shield of Durand cuts magic 25/30/35/40/45% and physical exactly half that (12.5/15/17.5/20/22.5%).
audit.corrected: Stated in tldr and report[5].t: read the Colossal Smash wind-up, not the cast; hold Purge until the stance drops.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Justice Punch but gives no duration.
audit.why: The punish window is exactly the 11 seconds at rank 1 during which Galio has no way in and no way out.
audit.corrected: Cooldown line now carries the 11/10/9/8/7s figure.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[6] says 'Galio flips ahead' while win[6] and phases[6].side both say Urgot — the prose contradicts the chart row on the same page.
audit.why: The chart row is confirmed by the already-audited mirror, so the prose is what must change: Galio's 2+ item scaling is teamfight utility, not a 1v1 flip.
audit.corrected: whys[6] reworded to separate teamfight value from the side-lane duel.

edits.before: Bait his key tool — flip him on the Justice Punch cooldown and shred with W. Urgot wins by trading around Galio's Justice Punch and cashing the pattern: flip him on the Justice Punch cooldown and shred with W.
edits.after: Justice Punch (E) is 11s at rank 1 and his only gap-closer — bait it, then flip him with Disdain and hold Purge until he is committed. Shield of Durand cuts physical damage, so spray after he drops the stance.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Justice Punch: 11/10/9/8/7s dash-knockup. Spent, he has no way in and no way out — those seconds are when you walk him down with W.

edits.before: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 and it is his engage and his escape — commit only inside that window.

edits.before: Track Galio's Justice Punch: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. When it is down — Flip + W shred.
edits.after: Colossal Smash resets his auto — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. Justice Punch is 11s: flip and W-shred while it is down.

edits.before: Your R Fear Beyond Death out-duels his R Hero's Entrance in lane; just be aware his R is a roam/ganks tool, so ping MIA and don't overextend when it's up.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death out-duels him in a straight lane fight; Hero's Entrance is a 180s roam tool, so ping MIA when it is up and never overextend while he is gone.

edits.before: At 2+ items Galio flips ahead — global R and taunt out-value you in fights.
edits.after: At 2+ items his R and taunt swing fights, but the straight 1v1 stays yours.

notes: Kit-flag misfire (also recorded on the mirror): Urgot's Corrosive Charge (Q) is tagged 'dash' but Riot's text is 'Fires an explosive charge at the target location' — no movement. Disdain (E) is his only mobility. No chart edits proposed: the current chart already agrees with the audited galio__urgot mirror. Whether Fear Beyond Death's execute threshold is exactly 25% is asserted in existing breakdown.late/report[11] text and was not verifiable from the kit file ('health threshold'), so that text was left untouched.
